introText.text: Enter the address of your receiver. Everything else works without further settings.

ip.label: IP address of the receiver
ip.help: e.g. 192.168.1.50. Receivers found in your network are suggested (only while the instance is running).

infoSingleConnection.text: Before you start: in the receiver menu set Network → Network Control to “Always On”. The receiver accepts only one control connection at a time, so close other apps that control it (e.g. Home Assistant).

advancedText.text: Normally there is no need to change these settings.

pollInterval.label: Update interval (ms)
pollInterval.help: How often values the receiver does not report by itself are read, e.g. the sleep timer. 7000 = every 7 seconds

requestInterval.label: Pause between commands (ms)
requestInterval.help: Only increase it if the receiver misses commands. Minimum 50

telnetPort.label: Port
telnetPort.help: Always 23. Only change it for a serial-to-network converter

useHttpInfo.label: Detect brand, model and zones automatically
useHttpInfo.help: Recommended. Reads this information from the receiver at startup
